name: Elder shaman
description: The old shaman of the Circle of Nel Toth who administers the Dreamfire Draught and stops Kael from killing Meren, leaving her to die alone.

description_citations.text: "All the Cairns of Jund" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Meren, an apprentice shaman, is anointed by the Circle of Nel Toth with the Dreamfire Draught for her trial to become a full shaman.
timeline.quote: We of the Circle of Nel Toth anoint you, Meren, child of stone and blood and bone, with the Dreamfire Draught.

citation.text: "All the Cairns of Jund" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: In the trial, a massive elemental forms from the earth and the Circle chants as Meren must bind it while poison racks her body.
timeline.quote: Before her, coalescing from the earth, a massive elemental reared up.

citation.text: "All the Cairns of Jund" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Flashback: the elder shaman stops the killing, ruling the trial continues until the draught is purged or she dies, and the Circle leaves her to die.
timeline.quote: Let her conclude the trial alone.

citation.text: "All the Cairns of Jund" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2015.
